declarations.docstring: Constructs a direct-sum tensor-product description whose component maps intertwine the indicated group actions.
States that the indicated tensor construction is linearly equivalent to a direct sum of tensor products.
Identifies the algebra generated by tensor-product maps with the displayed auxiliary algebra.
Provides a ring structure on the subtype defined by the displayed auxiliary set.
Produces a set outside which subtracting a scalar multiple of the identity from an endomorphism is a unit.
Proves simplicity of a representation module when its action agrees with the specified tensor-product action.
Defines an endomorphism of the tensor product from an endomorphism and a finite set of indices.
Evaluates the finite-set tensor-product map at the universal finite set.
Shows that all coefficients lie in a submodule when sufficiently many distinct polynomial evaluations do.
An invariant submodule is either bottom or top under the stated unit-action hypothesis.
Shows that a submodule invariant under the given units is closed under scalar multiplication by the displayed subtype.
Provides a ring structure on the subtype defined by the displayed alternate auxiliary set.
Defines an indexed family of endomorphisms of a tensor product.
Computes the zeroth member of the indexed tensor-product endomorphism family.
Places the tensor-product map of every endomorphism in the span of maps induced by units.
Expands the tensor-product map of an endomorphism minus a scalar identity as a finite power sum.
